Facebook got ruined when someone made a web robot that can make automated posts to all groups the account belongs to to include any link or picture and even tag people in them. So spammers make a fake account and steal a picture of a cute girl for the avatar picture, join up dating groups and mass add people as friends and the lonely guys fall for it and friend the account. Then the account starts posting spammy links and pictures to promote products and services.

Another thing is social network video games, where you have to add people as friends to get more stuff in the game. You end up with a lot of foreigners as your friends and they post bizarre stuff from their nation that might be offensive in your nation. Then you get auto added to their groups about the games and other stuff.
